newsitem.title: USA: Ky. education bonds repriced, 1998 yield raised.
newsitem.headline: Ky. education bonds repriced, 1998 yield raised.

text.p: PaineWebber Inc. said Wednesday it repriced Kentucky Higher Education Student Loan Corp.'s $4.9 million bond deal, raising the 1998 yield to 4.40 percent from 4.35 percent.
